data.content_ref: inline:SRC_004 claims the entire question is underdetermined pending the self-delimiting-framing property, but its own second countercondition identifies a path that does not require that fact: if append-only identity concerns write-ordering rather than read-back interpretation, any partial fragment can be quarantined on detection regardless of framing. The problem explicitly demands adjudication 'wherever the evidence allows,' and a conservative rule (refuse when a fragment cannot be confirmed complete, permit when a clean boundary is verifiable) is adjudicable without resolving the framing question. By declaring the whole question underdetermined, SRC_004 fails to adjudicate where evidence — specifically the quarantine-based criterion it itself lists — does permit a decision.
